mapper.select: SELECT msg_id, sender_id, sender_nm, receiver_id, receiver_nm, content, sent_at, read_at FROM MSGR_MESSAGE WHERE (sender_id = #{uniqId} AND receiver_id = #{partnerId}) OR (sender_id = #{partnerId} AND receiver_id = #{uniqId}) ORDER BY sent_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MSGR_MESSAGE (sender_id, sender_nm, receiver_id, receiver_nm, content, sent_at) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{senderNm}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverNm}, #{content}, #{sentAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE MSGR_MESSAGE SET read_at = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{uniqId} AND sender_id = #{partnerId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM MSGR_MESSAGE WHERE receiver_id = #{value} AND read_at IS NULL
